g.text: DEPARTMENT OF COMPUTER SCIENCE — THE UNIVERSITY OF LAHORE
CS-311 Database Systems | COMPONENT #15: Normalization from 1NF to BCNF
INSTRUCTOR: Miss Duaa-e-Nadeem | Topic: Cinema Management System
SUBMISSION DETAILS:
Student: Talha Sarfraz & Group
SAP ID: 70150006 | Semester: Fall 2024
Date: December 2024
STEP 0: UNNORMALIZED FORM (UNF) — Universal Relation with Repeating Groups
Universal Schema: R_UNF ( Booking_ID, Booking_Date, Customer_ID, Customer_Name, Customer_Email, Customer_City, { Phone_Numbers },
Show_ID, Show_Date, Start_Time, Base_Price, Movie_ID, Movie_Title, Genre, Director, Screen_ID, Screen_Name, Screen_Type,
{ Seat_Number, Seat_Class, Ticket_Price, Barcode_Number }, { Item_ID, Item_Name, Quantity, Unit_Price }, Total_Paid )
⚠ Anomaly: Repeating groups in Seats/Tickets and Concession Items violate relation atomicity. Severe redundancy.
STEP 1: FIRST NORMAL FORM (1NF) — Elimination of Repeating Groups & Multivalued Attributes
Action: Flatten repeating groups into individual tuples. Multivalued phone numbers extracted into separate relation.
Composite Primary Key Defined: ( Booking_ID, Seat_ID, Item_ID )
Atomic Relation: R_1NF ( Booking_ID, Seat_ID, Item_ID, Customer_ID, Cust_Name, Cust_Email, Show_ID, Show_Date,
Movie_ID, Movie_Title, Screen_ID, Screen_Name, Ticket_Number, Barcode_No, Item_Qty, Unit_Price, Net_Payable )
⚠ 1NF Condition Satisfied: All column values are atomic. However, Partial Functional Dependencies exist on PK subsets.
STEP 2: SECOND NORMAL FORM (2NF) — Elimination of Partial Functional Dependencies
Identified Partial Dependencies on Composite Key (Booking_ID, Seat_ID, Item_ID):
• FD 1 (Partial): Booking_ID → Customer_ID, Show_ID, Booking_Timestamp, Net_Payable
• FD 2 (Partial): Seat_ID → Screen_ID, Row_Letter, Seat_Number, Seat_Class, Price_Multiplier
• FD 3 (Partial): Item_ID → Item_Name, Category, Unit_Price, Stock_Quantity
• FD 4 (Full): (Booking_ID, Seat_ID) → Ticket_Number, Barcode_Number, Final_Price
• FD 5 (Full): (Order_ID, Item_ID) → Quantity, Unit_Price_Charged, Subtotal
Decomposed 2NF Relations:
1. Booking ( Booking_ID, Customer_ID, Show_ID, Booking_Timestamp, Net_Payable )
2. Ticket ( Ticket_ID, Booking_ID, Seat_ID, Ticket_Number, Barcode_Number, Final_Price )
3. Seat ( Seat_ID, Screen_ID, Seat_Code, Seat_Class )
4. Tuck_Shop ( Item_ID, Item_Name, Unit_Price )
STEP 3: THIRD NORMAL FORM (3NF) — Elimination of Transitive Functional Dependencies (X → Y, Y → Z)
Identified Transitive Functional Dependencies:
• In Booking relation: Booking_ID → Customer_ID AND Customer_ID → { First_Name, Last_Name, Email, City }
↪ Transitive Dependency: Booking_ID → Customer Demographics (Violates 3NF)
• In Booking relation: Booking_ID → Show_ID AND Show_ID → { Movie_ID, Screen_ID, Start_Time, Base_Price }
↪ Transitive Dependency: Booking_ID → Show Scheduling Details (Violates 3NF)
• In Showtime relation: Show_ID → Movie_ID AND Movie_ID → { Title, Genre, Duration_Minutes, Director }
↪ Transitive Dependency: Show_ID → Movie Metadata (Violates 3NF)
Action: Non-key determinants extracted into independent relations Customer, Showtime, Movie, Screen.
✓ Every non-prime attribute is now directly dependent upon the Primary Key, the whole Primary Key, and nothing but the Primary Key!
STEP 4: BOYCE-CODD NORMAL FORM (BCNF) — Strict Determinant Constraint Enforcement
BCNF Definition: A relation R is in BCNF if and only if for every non-trivial functional dependency X → Y, X is a Superkey.
Verification of Candidate Keys & Alternate Determinants:
• In Customer: Customer_ID (PK) is a superkey. Also Email is UNIQUE → Email is a candidate key. Both determinants are superkeys!
• In Ticket: Ticket_ID (PK) is a superkey. Also Ticket_Number and Barcode_Number are UNIQUE candidate keys. Satisfies BCNF!
• In Employee: Employee_ID (PK) is superkey. Also CNIC (National ID) is UNIQUE candidate key. Satisfies BCNF!
• In Parking: Parking_ID (PK) is superkey. License_Plate is monitored per slot. Satisfies BCNF!
• In Screen Subclasses: Screen_ID (PK) and Commercial_License_Code / Lounge_Access_Code are superkeys. Satisfies BCNF!
✔ BCNF VERDICT: Zero anomalies remain. All determinants are genuine superkeys. Lossless join & dependency preservation hold!
FINAL NORMALIZED RELATIONAL SCHEMA (19 Tables in BCNF — Strictly >= 10 Attributes Each):
1. Customer ( Customer_ID, First_Name, Last_Name, Email [UQ], Gender, DOB, Membership, Reg_Date, Loyalty_Pts, City, Postal, Is_Active )
2. Phone_Number ( Phone_Num, Customer_ID, Phone_Type, Country_Code, Telecom_Carrier, Is_Primary, WhatsApp, Verif_Status, SMS_OptIn, Added_Date )
3. Movie ( Movie_ID, Title, Genre, Duration, Release_Date, Language, Director, Age_Rating, IMDb_Rating, Budget, Box_Office, Status )
4. Screen ( Screen_ID, Screen_Name [UQ], Screen_Type, Total_Capacity, Row_Count, Seats_Per_Row, Sound_System, Projector, Width, Height, Clean_Status, Is_Active )
5. IMAXScreen ( Screen_ID, Laser_Proj, Aspect_Ratio, Dual_3D, Curved_Angle, Channels, Max_Luminance, HFR, Calib_Days, License_Code [UQ] )
6. GoldScreen ( Screen_ID, Lounge_Service, Recliner, Butler, Snack_Tier, Call_Button, USB_Watts, Legrest_Max, Pillow_Blanket, Lounge_Code [UQ] )
7. PremiumScreen ( Screen_ID, Luxury_Level, Balcony_Seats, Wine_Bar, VIP_Restroom, Heated_Seats, Acoustic_Rating, Coat_Check, Concierge, Noise_Db )
8. SilverScreen ( Screen_ID, Discount_Tier, Economy_Bundle, Student_Pass, Group_Discount, Free_Refill, Aisle_Ramp, Booster_Seats, Bulk_Ticket, Matinee_Rate )
9. Showtime ( Show_ID, Movie_ID, Screen_ID, Show_Date, Start_Time, End_Time, Base_Price, Show_Format, Available_Seats, Audio, Subtitle, Status )
10. Seat ( Seat_ID, Screen_ID, Row_Letter, Seat_Number, Seat_Code, Seat_Class, Price_Multiplier, Wheelchair, Reserved, Maintenance, Vibration, Color )
11. Booking ( Booking_ID, Customer_ID, Show_ID, Booking_Timestamp, Total_Seats, Total_Amount, Discount, Tax, Net_Payable, Status, Pay_Status, Channel )
12. Ticket, 13. Employee, 14. Tuck_Shop, 15. Concession_Order, 16. Concession_Item_Order, 17. Parking, 18. Checkpoint, 19. Movie_Review
